findings.title: Conditional reference inputs are not checked against the frozen plan/seal
findings.finding: The integrated report takes its schedule from seal.observer_plan and prevalidates scheduled feeds through measure_checkpoint. However, conditional_pair independently rereads the current seed contract, seed manifest/source bytes and evaluation suite to construct reference_tasks without comparing them to the sealed root, panel or seed bindings. A changed reference input can therefore silently redefine the purported fixed comparison while the originally sealed plan remains unchanged.
findings.qualification: The earlier missing feed-binding check is not an ordinary report-path bypass: measure_checkpoint validates those bindings first. Direct use of conditional_pair still relies on that unstated precondition. This finding concerns the unverified reference inputs, not a demonstrated research decision leak.
findings.acceptance: Bind conditional reference construction to the original seal/plan/source snapshots and reject or explicitly invalidate changed fixed inputs; do not relabel a changed panel as the original comparison.

findings.title: Conditional byte count still encodes a portfolio of alternative derivations
findings.finding: The new theory dictionaries and introduced-overhead split are real improvements. But conditional_description_bytes serializes every retained root reduction and its residuals together. These are alternative partial derivations of one goal, not necessarily the one current remaining-goal witness. Adding an unused historical route increases this number even when the chosen/current obligation has not changed.
findings.qualification: This can be an honest conditional portfolio-description metric. It is no longer merely the previous cumulative source bundle, and no minimal/uncomputable representation or forced decrease is requested. The current metric should not silently stand in for a bound current remaining-goal witness.
findings.acceptance: Identify the encoded object explicitly. If claiming a current residual/proof-description comparison, bind that witness per fixed goal separately from the retained portfolio, with new dictionary/gluing overhead and unknown proof remainder separate. Do not manufacture a sawtooth.
